entities.name: Masjid al-Qiblatayn
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Masjid al-Qiblatayn is a former mosque, in a partial ruinous state, located in Zeila, in the western Awdal region of Somaliland, in northern Somalia. The name of the mosque reflects the belief that it was once aligned to both Mecca and Jerusalem.
